How to get a Gemini key

1. Press “Open Google AI Studio” below. The page aistudio.google.com/app/apikey opens.
2. Sign in with your Google account (the same as for Gmail or YouTube).
3. Press “Create API key”. If Google asks for a project, choose the one it offers, or create a new one.
4. Copy the key (a long line that starts with AIza).
5. Come back here, paste it into the Gemini key field, and press “Test and save the key”.
The Gemini Flash models have a free tier, and no payment card is needed. Keep the key to yourself, like a password.
Privacy: the YouTube address of a video goes to Google’s Gemini, with your own key, only when you ask for descriptions. The key and the descriptions stay on this phone. The app collects nothing.
